body:
READ-ONLY ADR SCOPE MAP for bd-01M17J1GXY5GG4XZXMBREKY1S8.

Recommendation: reject blank or whitespace-only input through two distinct semantic opaque types, PromptTemplateVersion in core and FindingNote in acquire. Preserve every nonblank value byte-for-byte; do not trim it into a second hidden canonicalization. ProviderCall and CriticFinding may remain case classes because an opaque validated field prevents copy or fromProduct from smuggling a raw String. Each companion should expose from returning Either[DomainError, A], plus a validating unsafe helper only for source literals, matching existing core style.

Why not one NonBlankString: design rule 2 requires semantic types, and template version versus free-text finding note are not interchangeable.

Wire effect: ProviderCall JSON stays nullable string and nonblank payloads remain byte-identical, but the decoder must reject blank legacy payloads explicitly. CriticFinding currently has no repository codec. ReceiptRendering and NarrativeCompiler should render wrapper.value; their existing explicit none/some framing stays as defense in depth.

Measured source impact: main production constructors in embed-core, embed-grakern, and amr-interop pass None and need no migration. Nonblank Some construction occurs in acquire Fixtures, embed ReceiptDigestSuite, document CompilerSuite, and the WOG vertical. Additional semantic paths are core provenance plus a construction law, acquire critic plus generator/law, codec core plus decoder court, embed contract plus receipt digest property, and document compiler plus replacement of the now-invalid Some-empty laws.

Acceptance property: PromptTemplateVersion.from(empty or whitespace) and FindingNote.from(empty or whitespace) are Left; nonblank round-trips exactly; ProviderCall JSON decode refuses blank; no NarrativeCompilation fixture can construct or retain the ambiguous value; receipt and narrative fingerprints still change for distinct admitted nonblank values.

This is source/API incompatible by field type, so I recommend a dedicated ADR 0006 rather than hiding it in compiler validation. I can own the isolated migration if the chief approves that ADR path and this scope.
